title: Balance transaction helpers read a field Stripe does not send

bugs.note: The kind of a Stripe customer balance transaction is in its type field; there is no balance_type. balanceType() always returns null and both checkout-session predicates are always false, so code that uses them to tell a Checkout subscription payment, or its reversal, from other credits and debits misclassifies every such movement of the customer balance.
